acceptanceCriteria: Every customer query is owner-scoped in SQL; a foreign or archived id -> 404
POST /api/requests counts and inserts in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE (RS_MAX_REQUESTS_PER_CUSTOMER_PER_DAY, Asia/Amman day) -> 429 requests_per_day (SEC-2)
POST /api/requests/:id/confirm takes values only; without an extraction every confirmed field gets provenance manual; REQUIREMENTS_INCOMPLETE for missing core fields; a new requirements version
POST /api/requests/:id/plan stores the planning run and a proposed version (plan_json, alternatives, planHash, trace, explanation) or an infeasible run with blocking, candidate codes and relaxations

RS-12: approve requires expectedTotalCents and planHash; mismatch -> 409 PLAN_CHANGED with current values; stored plan failing re-validation -> 409 PLAN_INVALID; approve with budget or deadline missing -> 409 MISSING_BUDGET / MISSING_DEADLINE (budget first)

RS-36: GET /api/requests/:id returns RequestView whose rescueStatus is computed by derive.js on each read with one query per table; schema-no-rescue-status.test.js finds no column named like rescue status and no status column on rescue_requests
Labels object on every response with seeded prices (priceNotice, demoData) and demo flags on supplier, offer and product objects
FU-1: a planner limit is a typed 422 VALIDATION_FAILED (plan / planner_limit), no run stored, status unchanged
FU-7: the view service builds deriveRescueStatus input in the snake_case shape of derive.js
FU-8: POST /api/requests/:id/plan is rate-limited per customer in rate_events with 429 RATE_LIMITED, details.limit plan, Retry-After
completedWork: ROUTES (policy 'customer'): GET /api/requests (newest 100, rescueStatus {status,nextStep}, totalCents of the current non-closed plan, labels), POST /api/requests (201 {request:{id,createdAt,language,intakeStatus:'draft'}}), GET /api/requests/:id (RequestView), POST /api/requests/:id/confirm (201 {requirements,rescueStatus}), POST /api/requests/:id/plan (201 {planningRun, plan|null, labels}), POST /api/plans/:id/approve (200 {plan, approvalsNeeded, labels}). A foreign, archived or deleted id is 404, checked before the body is read; malformed ids are 400. REQUESTS (services/requests.js): the Asia/Amman day count (rate_events kind request_create, key u:<id>) and the insert share one BEGIN IMMEDIATE; the 11th is 429 requests_per_day with Retry-After to local midnight; deleting requests does not reset the count. language is detected from Arabic/Latin letter shares. CONFIRM: only the nine values are read (a client provenance is ignored, SEC-8); provenance and originalWording are kept from the latest usable (schema_ok, not degraded) extraction only when the submitted value equals the extracted known value, otherwise manual; empty fields are unknown/none; core fields are productType, cupQuantity, lidQuantity, capacityMl, diameterMm, maxPickups (missing -> 422 REQUIREMENTS_INCOMPLETE with details.fields, bad value -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED); budget and deadline are optional here so the plan can be made but not approved (RS-04); a contradictory productType/quantity pair is refused (cups needs lidQuantity 0, lids needs cupQuantity 0, cups_and_lids needs both >= 1); every confirm is a new version; an executing/executed version -> 409 PLAN_IN_PROGRESS; a change of values supersedes proposed/approved versions (REQUIREMENTS_CHANGED) and queues a replan_queue entry (status replanning, row 4a) that the next plan removes. PLANNING (services/plans.js): runPlanningFor takes a catalog snapshot (bundle offers with cup and lid items, availability = on_hand - reserved, confirmed compatibility, suppliers that refused an order of this request excluded), runs the planner outside any transaction, then in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE re-reads the snapshot and refuses to store a result computed on a changed catalog (offers_hash and requirements version; up to 3 attempts, then 503 DB_BUSY); it stores the planning run (trace, rejections, candidate codes, relaxations, blocking, excluded suppliers, offers_hash) and, if feasible, a proposed version (plan_json = PlanBody, planHash = canonicalHash(body), alternatives, total, pickups, ready_at), supersedes earlier open versions (REPLANNED) and points them at the new one, deletes the replan_queue entry, audits. FU-1: PlannerLimitError/code PLANNER_LIMIT -> 422 VALIDATION_FAILED details.fields [{field:'plan',rule:'planner_limit'}]; nothing stored; the slot is still counted. FU-8: takePlanSlot counts per customer in rate_events (kind 'general', key 'plan:u:<id>'; 002_requests.sql CHECK has no 'plan' kind and migrations are outside this task) in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE, default 10 per 10 minutes, 429 RATE_LIMITED details.limit 'plan' with Retry-After; only a request that would run the planner uses a slot (404 and no-requirements 409 do not). APPROVE: 404 -> body 422 (expectedTotalCents int, planHash 64 lowercase hex) -> superseded 409 PLAN_SUPERSEDED / non_executable 409 PLAN_NOT_EXECUTABLE (details.reason) / approved with same hash and total 200 unchanged / other states 409 INVALID_STATE -> MISSING_BUDGET then MISSING_DEADLINE (from the requirements version the plan was made for) -> server re-validation (hash of the stored body, cups/lids >= required, pickups <= max, totals consistent, budget, deadline) 409 PLAN_INVALID with details.reason -> hash/total mismatch 409 PLAN_CHANGED with details {currentPlanHash, currentTotalCents} -> CAS proposed->approved, plan_approvals row, audit; refused guards are audited as 'denied' with the code only. VIEW (services/view.js): loadRequestData does one SELECT per table for all requests asked for (images, extractions, requirements, planning_runs, plan_versions, reservations, reservation_items, supplier_orders, payment_operations, provider_calls, pickup_confirmations, replan_queue) in one read snapshot; deriveInput hands derive.js the snake_case rows and camelCase limits from config (FU-7); the rescue status is derived on every read (nothing is stored) and explained with explain.js templates; row 14 logs derive.fallback (code DERIVE_FALLBACK, requestRef). The RequestView carries request, extraction, requirements, planning (latest run of the current requirements version), plans (newest first), currentPlanId, reservation, orders, cancellingOrders (older versions with outstanding voids/refunds), rescueStatus with underlying, labels. app.js: createApp now takes planner (default domain planner(), read per request so a test can inject one), planRate ({limit, windowMs}; else config.planRateLimit/planRateWindowMin when present, else 10 per 10 min) and voidRule (c3's hook); resolvePlanRate is exported. TESTS: 65 cases in the four files under the net guard, named by criterion (RS-12, RS-04, RS-27, RS-36 (i)-(iv), SEC-2, SEC-8, PB-3/RISK-19, FU-1/FU-7/FU-8, RS-34, RS-09, RS-19, RS-30). Full suite 669/669, NFR5 p95 69.8 ms.

rate_events.kind has no 'plan' value, so planning is counted under kind 'general' with user_key 'plan:u:<userId>'. The general 300/min per-user limit (c1's open item, still unassigned, NOT taken here) must key on 'u:<userId>' and must not count 'plan:' keys; if a later task wants a dedicated kind it needs a new migration (migrations are append-only).

The contract fixtures (owned by c5) show plan-create and plan-approve responses without `labels` and with supplierName 'Supplier A'. This task follows the spec's convention (any response with seeded prices carries labels) and so adds a top-level `labels` to POST /plan and POST /approve; supplierName is the planner default 'Supplier <code>'. If a contract test compares exact key sets, the fixtures or this choice need aligning.

Void-rule hook for c3: supersedeOpenVersions (services/plans.js) refuses with 409 PLAN_IN_PROGRESS when a version to supersede holds a live reservation (active, consumed, reconciling) and no ctx.voidRule is configured, so stock is never left reserved under a superseded plan. c3 must wire createApp({voidRule}) with voidRule(db, {planVersionId, reason}), called inside the superseding transaction and expected to release the reservation and cancel the operations; the status update to superseded is done by supersedeOpenVersions afterwards. f1 extends the same function for offer-change supersession.

Only bundle offers (a bundle product with a cup item and a lid item) are planned; single cup or lid offers are skipped. Order.commitment sums committed_qty_json as an array of {offerId, committedBundles|bundles} or an object of numbers (c3/e3 own that column's final shape). Order.presentation treats every order of a non_executable plan as cancelled_payment_incomplete unless refused, cancelled or refunded.

Not in this task: DELETE /api/requests/:id, image and extract routes, reserve/execute/abandon, the re-plan drain (f1) and the general rate limit. Status 'draft' is never written to plan_versions (versions are inserted as proposed).
